cars.name: Tesla Model 3 (Highland, 2024+)
cars.brief: NO LOGOS (user decision, overrides anything below): draw no badge, emblem, crest or brand lettering; leave that spot plain body or plain grille, badge=None and no SHOW_BADGE prims. Refreshed Tesla Model 3 'Highland' (2024+). Signature: no grille - a smooth nose; very slim angular headlights with the thin LED DRL line (white strokes), the slim lower intake slot and small side intakes, the T badge on the nose (simplified T behind SHOW_BADGE), the smooth rounded hood. Clean and minimal - a mostly white face is correct for this car.

cars.name: Tesla Model S Plaid (2021+)
cars.brief: NO LOGOS (user decision, overrides anything below): draw no badge, emblem, crest or brand lettering; leave that spot plain body or plain grille, badge=None and no SHOW_BADGE prims. Tesla Model S Plaid (2021+ refresh). Signature: smooth grille-less nose with the T badge (simplified T behind SHOW_BADGE), wide headlights with the LED DRL arc (white strokes), the wide lower intake band with mesh (relief hex/grid) and small side openings, the gently sloped hood with two soft creases. Must be clearly different from the Model 3 in the same batch (wider, flatter lamps, bigger lower intake).
